title: Aromatic Algerian Turkey Neck Tagine
description: A savory and comforting dish featuring smoked turkey neck, perfect for a sick day, cooked in a banana leaf vessel with aromatic spices, this sugar-free-friendly recipe is sure to warm your belly and your soul.
instructions: In a large bowl, mix together olive oil, onion, garlic, ginger, cumin, coriander, and cayenne pepper.
Add the smoked turkey neck to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Lay a banana leaf flat on a work surface and place a quarter of the turkey neck mixture in the center of the leaf.
Fold the leaf over the filling to form a packet, and repeat with the remaining ingredients.
Place the packets in a large baking dish and cover with foil.
Bake for 2 hours, then remove the foil and bake for an additional 30 minutes.
Serve the tagine hot, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
